annotation.title_clean: Gobierno de Daniel Noboa presenta la Estrategia para la Inteligencia Artificial en Ecuador
annotation.title_en: Daniel Noboa's Government Presents the Artificial Intelligence Strategy for Ecuador
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de Telecomunicaciones y de la Sociedad de la Información (MINTEL), Ecuador
annotation.venue: Ministerio de Telecomunicaciones y de la Sociedad de la Información website
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Ecuador's telecommunications ministry press release announcing the national strategy for ethical and responsible AI (EFIA), developed with IDB and UNESCO support. It outlines three pillars: AI governance, capacity and technology, and AI adoption and development. No robotics or embodied AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: EFIA presented 10 March 2026 by Minister Roberto Kury
Pillar 1: AI governance with ethical, responsible, transparent framework
Pillar 2: capacity and technology (talent, digital infrastructure, data governance)
Pillar 3: AI adoption and development in public and private sectors
Developed with IDB and UNESCO support, human-centred approach
